title: DEPHYRIER Reinstaler (Vercel Deauth)
style: integration ledger anthem, 91 bpm, English Spanish French trilingual, deadpan deauth recital, terminal core, slack-activity vibe, integration-map flow, DEPHYRIER signature, deadpan reinstall chorus
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Vercel integration no longer authorized
Team X B seven I G M I eight U Q X three
P D X K L E F s V P y two the ID
March eighth the deauth notice arrived for me

[Pre-Chorus — Spanish]
La integración cayó reinstalar requerida
El equipo perdió la conexión medida
(The integration fell reinstall required / The team lost the measured connection)

[Chorus — trilingual]
Reinstall reinstall reinstaler reinstalar
The Vercel link broken on the bar
March eighth the notice in the activity feed
Operator action required to proceed

[Verse 2 — English]
Notion workspace connected the same Saturday
March seventh the Heygen install on display
Drive notifications turned on by zyn app
The stack accumulates the integration map

[Bridge — French]
La pile s'accumule intégrations sans fin
Vercel déconnecté sur le chemin
(The stack accumulates integrations without end / Vercel disconnected on the path)

[Outro — trilingual]
Reinstall reinstaler reinstalar the link
The activity feed shows the broken sync
